comparison.row_selector_policy: Four paired nuclides (C-14, Ni-59, Ni-63, Nb-94) have general and activated-metal rows. The general row applies to nonmetal/general form; the activated-metal row replaces it for activated metal, so both variants never apply to one component. The other 17 rows use all waste forms. Printed labels remain in `label`; canonical selectors are in `selector`; fixed group membership is enumerated in `members`.

printed_source_defects_preserved.detail: Cs-137 Table 8-5 Class C is literally 460 Ci/m3; Part 61 Table 2 gives 4600. The selected draft screen retains 460.
Activated-metal Nb-94 is literally 0.2/0.2/2 Ci/m3; the general Nb-94 row is 0.02/0.02/0.2 and Part 61 Class C is 0.2.
Section 8.11 prose and Appendix Q refer to Table 8-4, but displayed Table 8-5 is the intrusion table and Table 8-4 is tritium bioassay.
Appendix Q has the typo 'the activity or is 0.01 or more'.
The draft cites 49 CFR 172.101, Appendix A but supplies the unrelated title 'Office of Hazardous Materials Transportation Color Tolerance Charts and Tables'.
